compatibility: Same numeric/calendar/lag/rolling semantics as gold-features-v1; bootstrap rows reused, not recomputed
snapshot_semantics: historical_cutoff is the first release/materialization of each immutable issue block, not a duplicated full snapshot
selection: feature historical_cutoff <= requested released snapshot; label target_date <= fit/evaluation availability and historical_cutoff <= snapshot
incremental: Only issue dates in newly released month, plus 27 calendar days read context; final partial month ends at observed_end
labels: Separate, append-only, absent dates stay absent; never COALESCE to zero
idempotency: One transaction per new month, shared publication lock, code hash and bidirectional EXCEPT; no updates to v1
authorization: operator-only SQL authorization required before monthly staging; no scheduled releases
source: training.sales only; no unknown auxiliaries or global profiling statistics
